biography.plain_text: Mohammed Abdul Rahim Al Ali is a retired Emirati lieutenant-general who served as assistant undersecretary at the Ministry of Defence. He founded Al Ali Property Investment in 1985, a Dubai property developer and landlord. His son Jassim joined the family company after university and went on to lead its operations.

long_biography.plain_text:
Emirati businessman Mohammed Abdul Rahim Al Ali signed a partnership with Dubai Maritime City and Sharaf Investments to develop the Dolphin Residence in 2014. The proposed complex combined offices and homes with a hotel and shopping facilities. Its commercial plan offered preferential office rates to shipping operators, managers and marine insurers, seeking tenants from the surrounding maritime industry.

His property company also joined Sharaf Investments to establish Dubai General Properties, appointing engineer Yousuf Sharaf as chief executive. The new venture planned to remodel the development in stages, beginning with its interiors. It also considered overseas partnerships, with India identified as an initial target.

His property company also joined Sharaf Investments to establish Dubai General Properties, appointing engineer Yousuf Sharaf as chief executive. The new venture planned to remodel the development in stages, beginning with its interiors. It also considered overseas partnerships, with India identified as an initial target.
